effect: Passive: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

effect: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

effect: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals Spiritdamage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

effect: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

effect: Become immune to bullets.

name: Infuser
effect: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

name: Vampiric Burst
